claims: In Paradise Season 2, "Alex" is not a person.
In Paradise Season 2, "Alex" is a highly sophisticated, top-secret computer program or AI designed for quantum time manipulation.
Sinatra uses "Alex" to send messages back in time to alter future events.
Initially, Alex was revealed to be the name of Henry Miller's wife.
Henry Miller's wife was suffering from Huntington's disease before she died.
Sinatra is the series' central character.
Sinatra uses "Alex" as a codename for a powerful, power-consuming technology aimed at manipulating timelines.
By Episode 7, it is heavily implied that Alex is an AI capable of sending warnings or messages back in time.
The character Link aims to stop or kill "Alex".
Stopping or killing "Alex" is later revealed to mean destroying or taking control of the time-bending technology.
The mystery of Alex is a central, recurring theme in Paradise Season 2.
